listing.name: Oompa Loompa Pirates 0.0.3
listing.summary: Oompa Loompa Pirates come, as mentioned, with a custom Star System (Loompa) and a custom Planet (Loompaland)
listing.aiSummary: Adds a custom pirate faction with a dedicated star system, planet, and self-edited portraits.

description:
Oompa Loompa Doopity Doo...
Boy do I have a surprise for you

This is the result of a crashout aaaand now we got an Oompa Loompa Pirate faction.
No custom ships (yet) only a star system with a relatively well-boosted Oompa-Loompa production and a couple of self-edited portraits for your amusement.
Oompa Loompa Pirates come, as mentioned, with a custom Star System (Loompa) and a custom Planet (Loompaland)

If you find any issues in my code or have some improvement ideas, let me have 'em. I'm not really a coder, more of an Actor and Musician but here ya go.

Nexerelin-Compatible, requires LazyLib, MagicLib and GraphicsLib

Thanks for the Downloadbutton WolframSegler <3

Some of the portraits included

Spoiler

I'll add more in the future probably as I still want to add custom music, custom names and more planets into it, besides I got to rework a couple of things already but I wanted this thing to be gameplay-ready for now

Changelog

Spoiler
18.07.2026 release of 0.0.3: - Added Planets 3 new Planets to Loompa System, changed Loompalands markets, planet settings and industry to accord for hyperindustrialization of the Oompa Loompas
- Written README.md
- set up names for the Oompa Loompas
- use .zip to package the mod, cleaned the project file up a bit, hope nothing broke

16.07.2026 release of 0.0.2: Made it functioning for now, works with Nexerelin, haven't quite tested it thoroughly yet tho

aiDescription: Introduces the Oompa Loompa Pirates faction, featuring a custom star system called Loompa and a planet named Loompaland. The mod includes self-edited portraits for the faction and is compatible with Nexerelin. It currently lacks custom ships but focuses on the faction's presence and planetary setup.

gallery.aiCaption: An emblem featuring a green-haired Oompa Loompa face above red lightning bolts.
A Comm Directory screen for Loompaland listing various Oompa Loompa characters and their roles.
